Kits Walk by Strand is a boutique rental building offering studio, 1, 2, and 3 bedroom homes just steps from the Arbutus Greenway. With plenty of westside charm in the heart of Kitsilano, Kits Walk offers high-level finishing, contemporary design, convenient building amenities, and transit options outside your door. Have a cat? No problem. Dogs too! Contact us today to experience this amazing community for yourself. Suite: 2 bedroom 2 bathroom located on the 5th floor facing Arbutus St (wonderful views) Interior sq.ft.: 725 NOTE: Photos in advertisement are only to show the interior finishing's of the home. Please refer to the image with the floorplan for the exact unit layout. Suite Features: Stylish and sophisticated kitchens featuring quartz countertops Flat-panel wood grain cabinetry and full size stainless steel appliances including a quiet in-suite Whirlpool washer and dryer Wide-plank vinyl wood flooring throughout all living areas Spacious closets and in-suite or below grade storage Secured state of the art keyless entry Private outdoor spaces Over height ceilings Plenty of natural light Amenities: Professional caretaker 24-hour camera surveillance, secured underground parking, personally coded entry fob Common lounge, kitchenette, and BBQ Outdoor common area with children's play area In-building Bike Room with maintenance bench Dog Wash station Free bike storage Parking available at an additional cost. NO move-in/ move-out fee.
